markScheme.exemplarAnswer: The setting is a remote coastal village, described as "perched on the edge of the cliff" which suggests it is dangerously close to the sea below. The houses are old and weather-worn, with "whitewashed walls peeling in the salt wind," indicating they have long been exposed to harsh coastal conditions. There is a single narrow road leading into the village, implying it is isolated and difficult to reach. The harbour below contains only "a handful of fishing boats," revealing that fishing is a key but small-scale industry in the community. Mark scheme: 1 mark for each valid point identified from the specified lines. Points must be distinct and accurately reflect information stated in the text. Own words or close paraphrase accepted.
